name: La Vita Nuova
source:
You wake up to find yourself in the dark corridors of a girl's mansion. You came here without consent, but maybe it's for your own good...

[From [url=https://kisaragirat.itch.io/la-vita-nu]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你醒來時，發現自己身處一名女孩宅邸的昏暗走廊中。你是未經同意被帶到這裡的，不過，這也許是為了你好……

[摘自[url=https://kisaragirat.itch.io/la-vita-nu]itch.io[/url]]
